Vej biriyani resipi | kele ke patte men vej biryani resipi | vej dam biryani vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke satha. shayad sabjiyon ke sanyojan aur masalon ke mishran ke sath bane lokapriy bhartiy chaval biriyani vyanjnon men se ek hai. yah mul rup se kele ke patte ke andar pakae gae biriyani chaval dam ke sath mans biryani ka mans mukt ya shakahari sanskaran hai. biriyani ka svad na keval kele ke patte men phansa hota hai balki atirikt kele ke svad chaval men prerit hote hain aur is prakar ek adbhut anubhav banate hain.
